explanation.summary: The missing wind speed is a weighted sum of all reference wind speeds, each shifted by its own delay τ; the weights are fitted by least squares on the time all farms measured, so references that agree with the target count more and their independent errors partly cancel. A reference that would get a negative weight is left out. A factor per wind direction sector then corrects what the references cannot see, such as the wake of a neighbouring turbine: it is the measured over the predicted wind in that sector outside the outage, pulled towards 1 where the sector has few values.
